swing_ideas.text: Strong up trend despite what the broad market has done. Looking for a breakout over these equal highs to get into blue sky territory.

Two inside candles on Thursday / Friday are over the prior pivot low around 48.15 area. Looking for that to hold and any breaks over the highs to trigger longs up toward the pivot high around 55. Not interested if price gets below 48.

Double bottom in force here with inside bars on Thursday / Friday. Liking the Thursday wick that holds Tuesday's high. Over the neckline near 384 looking for a small hurdle around 402, and then things open up into the 455.25 level. Not interested if the 350.25 breaks.

Similar to CMG with the inside bars being back over the prior low. Looking for a break over 100.65 for a move back towards the 110.25 area and then ATH around 114.5. Not interested if price accepts below the 93.5 area.

Daily double bottom, break of the neckline and a resistance trend line from the most recent range. Two possible entry points. Either breakout continuation gets acceptance over 32.5 and 35.3 becomes the target. Or a higher low pullback over 30.65 keeps buyers in control seeking trend continuation.
Large earnings gap to close overhead. Simple inside bar structure Thursday / Friday thats holding up over the prior breakout highs.

Inverted head and shoulders reversal is under way with the neckline in play this week. Looking for a move over the 158.25 level for a thin structure / gap fill target over head. Not interested if price never breaks the neckline area.

Market profile – Stronger sellers should have undoubtably closed the single prints on Thursday. Thursday / Friday value shifts higher. Note that the poor low could use some repair, but is not a forced issue if markets open higher Monday morning.
